caseManifest.title: Customer service CRM rollout: decide, deliver and hand over

documents.title: Deliverables with testable acceptance
documents.question: What must be delivered, and what evidence makes each work package acceptable?
documents.description: Six deliverable groups and 18 work packages keep business capability, data, safety, operations and governance in the same scope.

detail.description: The data/integration group links 20,000-record traceability, real-endpoint evidence and decisions for 80 duplicate candidates.

documents.title: A change decision that can stop
documents.question: Can the SMS request proceed, and what happens when evidence, safety or resources are insufficient?
documents.description: CR-01 compares +8 person-days / +JPY 600,000 with rejection and deferral, preserves Information Management blocking authority, and requires baseline revision and independent revalidation.

focusLabels: Block release of the proposed change until specified evidence is accepted
Conditional approval alone does not activate a changed baseline
detail.description: Evidence and safety blockers prevent conditional approval from silently becoming implementation authority.

documents.title: Actuals, forecasts and the unapproved implementation proposal
documents.question: Which dates are facts, which forecasts have slipped, and which future commitments still require approval?
documents.description: The integrated calendar keeps six baseline/current pairs, four pending trial decisions and all 30 implementation proposal entries on one timeline.

focusLabels: Forecast 10/18 / already overdue by status date
detail.description: The API forecast is six calendar days later than baseline and already overdue as of 10/14; trial migration forecasts a three-day slip.

documents.title: A single accountable owner for every decision
documents.question: Who can decide, who executes, and who must be consulted across the complete delivery lifecycle?
documents.description: The unchanged 14-by-8 responsibility matrix separates Sponsor scope authority, Business acceptance, independent Quality and preauthorized Operations rollback.

focusLabels: RACI-11 | Decide CR-01 SMS scope, cost and schedule
RACI-12 | Decide Go / No Go; defer if safety or recovery conditions fail
RACI-13 | Execute preauthorized emergency rollback, verify recovery and notify users
detail.description: Scope approval, Go / No Go and emergency rollback have different accountable owners and conditions.

documents.title: Triggers and evidence for future consequences
documents.question: What could happen next, what triggers action, and what residual exposure remains after the response?
documents.description: Seven future risks have explicit triggers, owners, actions, reviews and required evidence; the observed 401 failure remains an issue.

focusLabels: RISK-01 | A further CRM recovery delay could push trial integration testing
RISK-02 | Incorrect duplicate handling could reach production
detail.description: Current authentication and data-quality issues become causal inputs to future schedule and production risks.

documents.title: Observed problems with real closure conditions
documents.question: What is already wrong, who owns the next action, and what evidence would justify closing the item?
documents.description: Six open issues distinguish deadlines from forecasts and require proof for authentication recovery, data reconciliation, change decisions, resources, contacts and remaining tests.

focusLabels: ISSUE-01 | CRM sandbox authentication returns 401 | investigating
ISSUE-02 | Trial-migration reconciliation differences | awaiting rule decision
detail.description: The log records current blockers and insists that a forecast date or a count match alone cannot close an issue.

sources.workflow:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant Biz as Business participant PM as PM participant Dev as Development participant Ops as Operations participant Info as Info Mgmt participant QA as Quality participant Sponsor as Sponsor Note over Biz,Sponsor: CR-01 / ISSUE-03 / RISK-04 — fictional, as of 2026-10-14. Decisions pending 2026-10-16.
Request evidence: purpose, recipients and acceptance criteria. Baseline: in-app/email only, SMS excluded.
Provisional estimate: +8 person-days / +JPY 600,000. Biz->>PM: Request first-release SMS alt Request lacks evidence PM-->>Biz: Return for missing evidence else Assess the change without authorizing implementation Note over PM,QA: PM commissions parallel impact assessment. par Effort and delivery Dev-->>PM: Effort, date impact and alternatives and Personal data and external transmission Info-->>PM: Required evidence, safety blockers and owners and Operations Ops-->>PM: Operational constraints and handover checks and Independent validation QA-->>PM: Mandatory coverage and independent real-endpoint evidence end alt Information-management release conditions remain unmet Info-->>PM: Block release of the proposed change until specified evidence is accepted Note over PM,Sponsor: Sponsor cannot waive safety blockers. Keep the current baseline and CR-01 open. else Evidence permits Sponsor review PM->>Sponsor: Compare approval, deferral and rejection with cost, dates and residual risks alt Reject the request Sponsor-->>PM: Reject with reasons and reconsideration conditions else Defer SMS beyond the first release Sponsor-->>PM: Defer with an owner, next review date and required evidence or resources else Approve with explicit scope, funding and conditions Sponsor-->>PM: Conditionally approve only the recorded scope, cost and conditions Note over PM,Sponsor: Conditional approval alone does not activate a changed baseline alt Conditions or resources are still missing PM-->>Biz: Hold implementation, resolve conditions/resources else Conditions and resources are confirmed PM->>Dev: Version the baseline and authorize work Dev->>QA: Submit implementation and real-endpoint regression evidence Note over PM,QA: Failure or business return reopens linked work.
Retest and acceptance must pass. alt Verification fails, evidence is incomplete or escalation is required QA-->>Dev: Return defects, keep release blocked Note over PM,Sponsor: CR-01 remains open, escalation is not acceptance or release authority else Independent verification passes and blockers are cleared QA-->>Biz: Present independent results against the agreed criteria alt Business returns Biz-->>PM: Return unaccepted criteria else Business accepts Biz-->>PM: Accept with evidence PM->>PM: Close CR-01 with evidence end end end end opt Rejection or deferral PM-->>Biz: Notify decision and next review end end end

scenario.title: Customer service CRM rollout: decide, deliver and hand over
scenario.disclosure: All organizations, people, records, dates, amounts and results are fictional teaching data. This is not a customer deployment or a success claim.

firstRelease: SLA notices and reporting through in-app/email
excluded: SMS unless CR-01 is explicitly approved and its conditions are met

roles.title: Sponsor
roles.authority: Final accountability for purpose, budget, scope changes and Go / No Go. Cannot waive unmet data-safety or recovery conditions.

roles.title: Project Manager (PM)
roles.authority: Integrates plans, impact analysis, resources, registers and escalation; is not the final business acceptor for everything.

roles.title: Business Lead
roles.authority: Owns business scope, acceptance criteria and adoption by 40 users; resolves differences across the 3 service desks.

roles.title: Development Lead
roles.authority: Owns implementation, integration, retry and concurrency control. A supplier cannot replace internal integration accountability.

roles.title: Operations Lead
roles.authority: Owns night batches, monitoring, backup/recovery and handover; can execute preauthorized rollback when recorded triggers are met and must report it.

roles.title: Information Management Lead
roles.authority: Owns access, personal-data conditions, security exceptions and release-blocking evidence.

roles.title: Quality Lead
roles.authority: Owns independent validation, evidence and defect retesting; developer self-report does not replace verification.

roles.title: CRM Vendor
roles.authority: Provides sandbox authentication/API specifications and supports joint diagnosis; does not own internal business acceptance.

acceptanceGates.criterion: All 30 mandatory business acceptance cases pass; zero unresolved major defects.
Every one of 20,000 source records is traceable to the target or an approved exclusion; candidate decisions and business samples are evidenced.
Real-endpoint authentication, retry and concurrency checks pass; repeated submissions create zero duplicate registrations.
Production-specific access and personal-data controls are approved; a trial access pass is insufficient.
Agreed low-usage batch window, stop/rollback conditions, recovery reconciliation and business restart notifications are rehearsed.

trialAccess.scope: Trial environment only; no production safety clearance or full business acceptance.

changeRequests.request: Add SMS notifications to the first release

estimate.basis: Provisional fictional change estimate, not approved funding

decisions.question: Has the CRM Vendor supplied a credible cause and recovery response?
Are duplicate rules, CR-01 SMS and the capacity shortfall decided by their authorized owners?
Are primary/backup contacts and the night exception drill agreed?
Does the evidence justify trial completion and replanning for implementation?
Are data, safety, business and recovery conditions met? If not, defer with No Go.

interpretation: A forecast is not an actual completion. A planned decision is not an approval.
The 401 authentication failure is an observed issue; a further recovery delay is a future risk.
80 duplicate-key candidates are not 80 confirmed data losses, and record-count agreement alone is insufficient acceptance evidence.
The 3-person-day resource gap remains unresolved at the status date; no staffing success is claimed.
Emergency rollback under preauthorized conditions is distinct from authorization to change scope or budget.
AI may help summarize logs or draft analysis; these sources do not execute AI or production operations.
Shared runtime status and RACI legend text may remain Japanese; the case source content is English.
